outcome: One bounded real feature reaches a reviewable candidate and isolated running preview with independent acceptance.
currentProblem: No current phase receipt proves Oracle context plus real coding-agent execution plus observed usable output in one loop.
constraints: Research must compare reuse and the smallest existing-Core approach, inspect primary sources and pin selected versions before READY.
Future dependency plans are assumptions, not delivered truth; worker execution requires delivered dependencies and a current Jev-satisfied plan.
Real-provider and live-product evidence must be identified separately from deterministic mocks; no fabricated API runs, costs or judgments.
successCriteria: The real feature uses Oracle-resolved exact input refs, produces a real candidate and runs in an isolated preview whose release identity is recorded.
Independent QA observes functional behavior and rejects a seeded defect even when the producer says success.
At least three reset live runs and one kill/resume path have complete evidence, budgets and failure records; feasibility is reported separately from pilot value.
